answer.worked: $f(x)=(x-1)^2-1$. The minimum is $-1$ at $x=1$, which is included in the domain. Hence the range is $[-1,\infty)$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Determine the equation of the inverse function $f^{-1}(x)$ and its domain.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}y&=x^2-2x\\x&=y^2-2y\end{align*}$$
Complete the square:
$$\begin{align*}x&=(y-1)^2-1\\x+1&=(y-1)^2\\y-1&=\pm\sqrt{x+1}\end{align*}$$
The sketch shows the branch with $y\leq1$, so select the negative square root.
$$\begin{align*}y&=1-\sqrt{x+1}\\f^{-1}(x)&=1-\sqrt{x+1}\end{align*}$$
The domain of the inverse is the range of $f$: $[-1,\infty)$.
